name: Streamshield
author: Streamshield Ltd

sections.description:
Quickly add automated content moderation to any WordPress user-generated content using Streamshield. Scan text, images, video, and audio from various file formats with a simple API key. Achieve instant compliance, safety, and peace of mind with transparency reporting. Key features include:

  • Advanced machine learning models scan and categorize content at machine speed.
  • Automatically unpublish offensive content.
  • Detailed analytics and reports on all user-generated content.
  • Easy to use and quick to set up.
sections.installation:
Install

  • Install via plugin directory or upload files manually to your server.
  • Make sure your permalinks are not set to “plain”. This will make Streamshield’s image and file analyser unable to access the file contents.

Connect

Once the plugin is enabled, go to the Streamshield Admin page (under Settings) to register with the API key and secret generated for your domain in the Streamshield dashboard.
sections.faq:
What types of content can Streamshield moderate?

Streamshield is equipped to moderate a wide range of content, including text, images, videos, and audio. Our platform ensures comprehensive content moderation across various digital formats.

How does Streamshield use machine learning in content moderation?

Streamshield utilizes advanced machine learning algorithms to analyze and moderate content in real time. These algorithms are trained to identify and filter inappropriate or harmful content, ensuring compliance with community standards and legal guidelines.

Can Streamshield handle large volumes of user-generated content?

Absolutely. Streamshield is built to efficiently manage large volumes of user-generated content, making it ideal for platforms with high traffic and extensive user interaction.

What makes Streamshield different from other content moderation tools?

Streamshield stands out due to its advanced machine learning capabilities, ease of integration, scalability for handling large volumes of content, and commitment to user privacy and data security. Our solution is versatile and can be adapted to a wide range of digital platforms with simple integration.

Is Streamshield free to use?

Streamshield offers a trial period, after which a subscription is required based on the number of credits used. Please see our Pricing and Plan information page for details.
